comments.text: Guys if once you become an adult and you still worship a living girl or non living, there is something seriously wrong with you.

replies.author: @TheCivilizedMind
replies.text: It may seem strange from the outside, but the Kumari tradition is deeply rooted in Nepalese religion, history, and identity. Understanding a tradition doesn’t mean everyone has to agree with it.

comments.author: @TheCivilizedMind
comments.text: Nepal has lived with earthquakes, floods, landslides, and the Himalayas for generations. Do you think geography ultimately shapes a country more than politics does?
